notes.fatiha: The Makkan surah of seven ayat that opens the mushaf, recited in every unit of prayer. It moves from praise of God to a request for guidance.
notes.yasin: A Makkan surah of eighty-three ayat, named for the two letters that open it. It sets the signs of creation beside the account of the resurrection.
notes.rahman: A Madinan surah of seventy-eight ayat that returns to one question: which of your Lord's blessings would you deny? It sets the creation of the human being beside the order of the heavens.
notes.mulk: A Makkan surah of thirty ayat about the One in whose hand the kingdom rests and the trial of His creation. It opens the twenty-ninth juz of the mushaf.
notes.ikhlas: A Makkan surah of four ayat. It states God's oneness and self-sufficiency in a few lines.

bodies.revelation: The Qur'an was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and preserved as it was received.

bodies.standardisation: The caliph Uthman standardised the written codex and ordered copies to be made from it.
bodies.print: The printed and digital mushaf carries that text to the page you are reading now.
